job.title: Named Account Executive
job.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike is seeking a Corporate Account Executive to sell into our Mid-market segment. They will partner with our Sales Development, Sales Engineering, Channel Account Managers, and Marketing team to effectively break down barriers and showcase the value of our products. If you are a hunter, who enjoys the thrill of closing net new opportunities, then this is the role for you!

This role is remote with the exception of coming into the office 1 day a week if you reside near our Sunnyvale, CA or Austin, TX locations. This will be used for team bonding and collaboration.

We're looking to hire Account Executives that currently reside in the following locations:

• Sunnyvale, CA
• Austin, TX
• Boston, MA
• New York, NY
• Atlanta, GA
• Chicago, IL
• Nashville, TN
• Denver, CO
• Seattle, WA
• Phoenix, AZ

What You’ll Do:

• Run a full sales process from prospecting to close. 
• Strategize with our channel partners to drive net-new business. 
• Forecast and report updates to management team through Clari. 
• Become an insider within the cyber security industry and become an expert of CrowdStrike’s platform. 
• Stay well educated and informed about CrowdStrike’s competitive landscape and how to sell the value of our solutions and services when compared to the relevant competitors in the Next-Generation Endpoint Protection Platform marketspace. 
• May require modified work hours to accommodate accounts in other time zones, and minimal, but occasional travel for accounts that require a higher touch to achieve closure. 

What You'll Need:

• 1+ years of full sales cycle experience, generating net new business for a SaaS, Cloud, and/or Security solution. 
• 1+ years of experience carrying a dedicated sales quota, with responsibility for full sales cycle from sourcing to closing. 
• Experience with a consultative sales process with proven ability to sell a broad, multi-module solution to mid/enterprise organizations. 
• Confidence to sell into C-level Executives and/or Evaluator-level Security and IT Leadership. 
• Ability to execute a go-to-market strategy and prospect into accounts using SFDC, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, cold calling, emailing, and more. 
• Previous experience strategizing with Channel Partners which may include, but not be limited to, Value-Added-Resellers and Managed Service Providers 
• Track record of exceeding expectations in an individually focused, quota carrying role. 
• Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly. 
• Competitive nature, but also a collaborative team player. 
• Strong presentation skills, both in person and via virtual channels.

• Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

job.description:
About Buildout
Buildout is the AI deal engine for CRE brokerages, automating every step from first contact to commission. While brokers focus on relationships and winning listings, Buildout handles the workflows behind the scenes, turning manual processes into intelligent, scalable systems. Trusted by over 50,000 brokers, Buildout powers more profitable deals from lead to close. Learn more at www.buildout.com.

The Opportunity
We’re growing our Account Management team and hiring across multiple levels, from Associate Account Manager to Senior Account Manager. Whether you’re looking to take the next step into account management or you’ve spent years owning and growing complex customer relationships, we’re interested in meeting people who are energized by retention, growth, and delivering real value to customers.

As a quota-carrying AM, you’ll own renewals and growth across a high-volume book of business, including contract execution, license expansion, price increases, multi-threading relationships across every level of the account, and bringing in the right post-sale partners for support, including Support/Customer Success for product adoption and Account Executives for cross-sell opportunities. You’ll act as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for our customers, consistently delivering on their expectations and ensuring they’re getting the most value out of their Buildout package.

How you’ll contribute
Relationship Ownership & Results
• Consistently hit monthly and quarterly targets

• Build and maintain a living account plan, tying customer goals to Buildout workflows and including org map, renewal history, risk signals, expansion history, and key dates, as the system of record rather than something carried in memory

• Monitor account health through Salesforce, Planhat, and usage insights to catch churn triggers early. With a large book, the discipline isn't perfect recall; it's knowing exactly where to look and getting up to speed on any account in minutes, not hours

• Own the renewal calendar and drive early engagement, renewing customers at least 60 days ahead of contract start date

• Maintain immaculate CRM and pipeline hygiene, so every account's next step, risk status, and forecast category is clear to anyone who opens the record

• Represent Buildout in the market through conferences, customer events/meetings, and networking opportunities; this may include travel up to approximately one week per quarter as part of building relationships and driving revenue

• Understand the account's business, be a student of CRE and our competitive landscape

Swim Lanes & Hand-offs
• Serve as the customer’s internal champion and quarterback cross-team triage by collaborating with Product, Support, Sales, Implementation, Finance, and Customer Success to unblock issues, deliver insights, shape scalable playbooks, and strengthen customer outcomes

• Exercise real judgment on risk level: step back cleanly on routine hand-offs, stay close and track the fragile ones; know the relationship stays the AM's to protect either way

• Show up as one unified voice to the customer even when several internal teams are involved behind the scenes

Attitude & Team Approach
• Improve our AM motion by testing processes, sharing learnings, supporting education initiatives (webinars/trainings), and contributing to a collaborative, accountable, high-growth team environment

• Approach every conversation with curiosity and empathy, seeking to understand the customer’s point of view and treating issues as problems to solve, not threats to manage

• Meet setbacks with ownership and reflection, not defensiveness. When something goes wrong, the expectation is "what could I have done differently here," not justification or blame-shifting

Competencies
• Wired to hit the number, not managed to it – you don't need to be chased toward your target; hitting it is personal, and you treat every quarter like it's the one that counts

• Tech is leverage, not overhead – you treat Salesforce, Planhat, Gong, and every other tool in your stack as ways to scale yourself. You're looking for the faster way before someone hands it to you

• Empathy and curiosity as a discipline – you treat curiosity about the customer's world as a daily practice, staying genuinely open to their point of view even when you're the one delivering hard news

• Never lets a relationship live in one person – you're building the org map on purpose, so the account survives a champion leaving, getting overruled, or going quiet for a quarter

• Builds a team without a title – you collaborate cross-team exceptionally well, building strong relationships with the other folks who serve our customers, knowing it’s a team win when a customer chooses to spend their money with Buildout

• Diplomatically unshakeable – you can deliver a price increase or a hard truth without over-apologizing or reflexively discounting to relieve your own discomfort. You hold the line with warmth, not an apology attached.

• Juggling pro – you can comfortably jump between inbound customer requests, to demos, to strategic renewal conversations, as well as adjust and match tone based on the customer call

• Road-ready – you're comfortable getting on a plane for an onsite QBR, a renewal conversation, or an industry event. Facetime still closes deals and builds the trust this role depends on

What makes a great candidate
• B2B SaaS account management experience with a focus on retention and expansion (years of experience required varies by level)
• Associate level: experience in customer success, service, or sales

• Experience managing a high-volume book of business and proven ability to consistently hit revenue targets

• Experience nurturing customer relationships

• Experience with Salesforce (required); Planhat, ChurnZero, Gainsight or other Customer Success tooling is a plus

• Experience in the Commercial Real Estate industry is a plus

We know there are great candidates who won’t check all of these boxes, and we also know you might bring important skills that we haven’t considered. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

Reporting To: Director of Account Management
Location: This is a fully remote role open across most of the US.
Travel: This role includes occasional travel for conferences, customer meetings, and industry events. Travel may vary based on business needs.
Compensation: We’re hiring across multiple levels for this role, with anticipated on-target earnings (OTE) ranging from $90,000 to $135,000.
Compensation includes a base salary plus variable commission and typically follows an approximately 70% base / 30% variable pay mix.
The level at which a candidate is hired, and their compensation within this range, will be determined based on relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and the scope of responsibility they’re prepared to take on.

Perks & Benefits
This program includes:
• Impactful insurance and benefit options, including 2 medical plans to choose from, 100% coverage of employee dental and vision insurance premiums, HSA seed, company-paid STD, LTD, life insurance, and telemedicine, and a wellness benefit of $400/year.

• Policies that support a healthy work/life harmony, including Flexible PTO, 14 paid company holidays, paid parental leave, and give back days

• 401(k) with 4% company match and immediate vesting

• A fully remote work culture with a monthly remote work reimbursement ($600/year) to support our distributed team and an annual, in-person company kickoff

• Challenging problems to solve with a committed and supportive team who are invested in your growth and development

• A wonderfully quirky culture where you’re encouraged to bring your whole self to work
